name: Asakura Shizuka
source:
A girl who is the same class as Koudai. She doesn't go to school very often due to illness.

She is a shy girl. Fortunately for her naivete, she becomes a friend of koudai. She is tall for her age and has the most growth out of all the girls.

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complets/LRG/lrg_info.html]Official site[/url]]
